QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] Inescapable Destiny
QuestInfo.0: There's no way to know how much time has passed. And traveling through the labyrinth has been exhausting.
QuestInfo.1: Every time you hear people's voices and follow them through the door on the right, you just end up more lost than when you started...
QuestInfo.2: What can you possibly do when you have no control over any of it? How can you save the world like this?
